title: Demo student aid renewal
text: In this fictional student aid program, returning applicants submit a new renewal form for each academic year. Previous approval does not guarantee renewal. Start the renewal request in the demo student portal.

title: Demo student aid deadline
text: The fictional student aid renewal deadline is 15 May for the coming academic year. Submit the renewal form before the deadline through the demo student portal.

title: Demo international student aid
text: International students in the fictional program may request an eligibility review from the campus aid office. The office must confirm eligibility before an application is submitted; eligibility is not guaranteed.

title: Demo student aid required documents
text: A renewal application for the fictional student aid program requires the renewal form and current enrollment confirmation. Upload both documents in the demo student portal.

title: Demo driving license renewal
text: In the fictional driving license service, eligible residents can renew a license online using form DL-R1. If the demo portal reports that an in-person identity check is required, book an office appointment.

title: Demo lost license replacement
text: To replace a lost license in the fictional driving license service, submit replacement form DL-L2 through the demo portal. Replacement is a separate process from renewal.

title: Demo driving license address update
text: For the fictional driving license service, update a mailing address in the profile settings of the demo portal. Save the change and keep the displayed confirmation number.

title: Demo office appointment
text: The fictional license office accepts appointments through the demo booking page. Choose the identity-check appointment type and bring the confirmation notice and a photo identification document.

title: Demo benefit application status
text: In the fictional benefits service, view an application status under My Requests in the demo portal using the reference number. If no record appears, contact the demo support desk with that reference number.

title: Demo benefit bank details
text: To change benefit payment bank details in the fictional service, open Payment Settings and submit a verified account update request. Support staff must not request passwords or one-time authentication codes.

title: Demo veteran support appeal
text: For the fictional veteran support program, request a decision review using appeal form VA-A1 within 30 days of the demo decision notice. Attach the notice and submit through the demo review page.

title: Demo veteran support coverage
text: The fictional veteran support program covers only services listed in an approved support plan. To check an unlisted service, ask the program caseworker for a written coverage decision before booking.
